name: Hudson Hills Golf Course
sourceLabel: Published scorecard · Golfify; totals checked against county course page
cardNote: Black hole values and totals agree between Golfify and 18Birdies; the additional Green, Blue and Gold rows come from Golfify. The county course page confirms four tee sets and a par-71 championship layout. Ratings and slopes are omitted because they were not independently verified from an official card. Retrieved October 21, 2026. OSM hole 18 is mis-tagged par 6; the published cards identify it as par 4, while the original numbered route and coordinates remain unchanged.
